geometry.axes: X aft, Y right, Z up; metres/degrees
geometry.scope: Reduced wing model from sampled current native source-section curves. Solvers interpolate linearly between sections; a smooth CAD loft between them is approximated. Symmetry is an explicit modeling assumption, not verification of the opposite CAD wing. No fuselage, tail, rotor wash, control deflections, structural or flight validation.

scope: Steady incompressible inviscid wing-only VLM. CD is induced drag, not total aircraft drag. 2D NeuralFoil polars are separate estimates with reported confidence. No stall, propwash, aircraft stability, structural strength or flight approval. CAD smooth spanwise surfaces are approximated between source sections. Panel loads omit weight/inertia and attachment flexibility.
